name: URL health monitor with confirmed downtime alerts and a daily uptime report

parameters.content:
## URL health monitor with confirmed downtime alerts and a daily uptime report

### How it works

This workflow monitors a configured list of URLs every five minutes, records each check, and only raises alerts when a site’s health state changes. Each check looks at the status code, the response time and the text that must appear on the page, so it also catches pages that return 200 but are broken. A failed check is retried once, and a site is marked down only after two failed checks in a row, so short blips never trigger an alert. It logs incidents, sends separate downtime and recovery emails (with the downtime), and runs a second daily path that summarizes uptime over the last 24 hours compared with the previous 24 hours. After sending the daily report, it deletes check records older than 14 days.

### Setup steps

- Create two Data Tables. `url_checks`: url (string), ok (boolean), status_code (number), response_ms (number), reason (string), checked_at (string). `url_incidents`: url (string), status (string), reason (string), changed_at (string), downtime_minutes (number). The workflow finds both tables by name.
- Edit the “Build Website Check List” code node to list your URLs, the text each page must contain, and the slow-response threshold.
- Add an SMTP credential and set the sender and recipient in the three email nodes.
- Adjust the two schedule triggers if you want different check or report times.

### Customization

The timeout (10 s) and retry wait (5 s) are at the top of “Check Website Status”. The down/recovery rules are in “Evaluate Site Health”. Data retention (14 days) is in “Remove Old Check Data”.

## Start monitoring run

Triggers the recurring URL health check and loads existing incident and recent check history used to avoid duplicate or noisy alerts.

## Probe site health

Builds the configured site list, probes each URL for status, response time, and expected content, then evaluates the resulting health state for each site.

## Record state changes

Stores every check result, detects whether a site changed state, and logs incident records for confirmed changes.

## Send status alerts

Routes changed states into downtime or recovery paths and sends the corresponding notification email.

## Load report data

Starts the daily reporting branch and loads recent check and incident data needed for the uptime summary.

## Create daily report

Builds the uptime report comparing the latest 24-hour period with the prior 24 hours, then emails the report to recipients.

## Clean old records

Prunes old check records after the daily report has been sent to keep the data table manageable.
